newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina IRSA 9-mth net $22.73 mln vs $14.07 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentina IRSA 9-mth net $22.73 mln vs $14.07 mln.

text.p: Note: IRSA, one of Argentina's leading real estate companies, said its total assets in the first nine months of the year rose 39 percent to $440.36 million.
"The sales increases registered by IRSA over the last two quarters give us a signal of positive growth in the Argentine economy.

"We also believe that this trend will continue to improve throughout 1997 along with its corresponding positive impact for our company's businesses. Just as we had predicted, we can now confirm that the growth in the home mortgage loan market has evidently been the driving force behind the increase in property sales," IRSA said.
Full company name is IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones.
